answer: Propose one AI vote/key/day on marble extraction that could drain a karst meadow. Each key needs a human sponsor's daily 10-minute in-person check. Registrars deduplicate live biometrics and allow one key/person/day; failed checks or reuse deny the vote. Corrupt registrars or missed duplicates break the cap; sponsors can be hired. Attendance is recurring labor; scanners are reusable capital; no stake. Assuming sound checks, shared hosts and parallel agents cannot reuse sponsors: ten keys need ten people and 100 person-minutes/day, even if checks run simultaneously.
